question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a gold present, Bob has a white present, and Claire has a pink present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) gold present
(B) white present
(C) pink present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (gold, white, pink)
1. Swap Alice and Bob: (white, gold, pink)
2. Swap Claire and Bob: (white, pink, gold)
3. Swap Bob and Claire: (white, gold, pink)
Claire has the pink present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
